tool.name: Beacon2 Filtering Terms
tool.description: list the filters each beacon accepts
tool.command: beacon2-query filtering-terms @PROVIDER_ARGS@ #for $prefix in str($prefixes).split(','): #if $prefix.strip() --prefix '${prefix.strip()}' #end if #end for --terms 'filtering_terms.tsv' --outcomes 'outcomes.tsv'

param.name: prefixes
param.label: Only terms with these prefixes (optional)
param.help: Comma-separated CURIE prefixes, e.g. NCIT,HP. Matched case-insensitively.

tool.help:
**What it does**
@HELP_READS@
Lists the filtering terms each selected beacon accepts, with how many records carry each term where the beacon reports it. Every row also lists the other selected beacons offering the same term, so one table answers both "what can I filter on here" and "what can I filter on everywhere".
**Prefixes are selected here, not by the beacon**
Asking a beacon for a bare prefix such as ``EFO`` does not work: at least one implementation reads it as a term whose identifier is literally ``EFO``, finds nothing, and returns an empty list with no error. So the tool fetches each beacon's full list and selects by prefix itself, and the run report says so.
**Outputs**
*Terms*: one row per beacon and term. *Run report*: one row per beacon.
